# aip-retrieval-mcp-cli-gain-api — task plan

**S1 — The proxy owns retrieval and a filtered, durable gain ledger behind a shared HTTP client contract. (in_progress)**
- [ ] retrieval: POST /retrieval serves exact whole/lines/pattern CCR originals, preserves semantic errors/caps and zero-match success, without confusing GUID content IDs.
  - check: dotnet test --project tests/AiProxy.Tests --filter-class "*RetrievalEndpointTests"; observe lookup/range mutation fail then restore.
- [ ] gain: Durable summary/history/time aggregates and method/rule/layer/pipeline attribution use real ledger events with date/project/provider and attribution filters; all sections use identical scope. Unchanged and failed-compression requests are recorded too; UTC day/Monday week/month buckets and descending bounded history are deterministic.
  - check: dotnet test --project tests/AiProxy.Tests --filter-class "*Gain*" with timestamp-boundary, two-project, no-capture and restart fixtures; remove filter predicate and observe failure. Mixed-rule arithmetic fixture reconciles per-dimension totals without duplicate savings; invalid date/order/limit and SQL-like filter values are tested.
- [ ] measurement: All reduction counts declare estimated coefficient 2.89; actual characters/bytes and reported usage remain distinct; CCR followup cost is separate or net explicitly unavailable. Initial counts use actual forwarded body including CCR tool overhead and permit negative delta; no unobserved usage/status is filled with zero.
  - check: Gain tests assert fixture arithmetic and serialized method/capabilities; alter coefficient or relabel net and observe failure.
- [ ] identity: Private project header never reaches any upstream, and missing attribution stays unknown; recall reports do not infer originating project from hash.
  - check: Forwarding and CCR integration tests capture upstream headers and same-preview multi-project recall fixtures.
- [ ] reset: Filtered reset removes statistics and recalls through explicit cutoff, preserves newer concurrent events and all originals/captures.
  - check: Gain reset integration test seeds old/new events and an original, resets project/date scope, reads survivors and retrieval.
- [ ] port-client: Default communication URL is loopback:17432 while explicit --urls/environment/dynamic test binding wins; shared client bypasses system proxy and propagates cancellation/problem errors.
  - check: Host configuration and Client fake-handler tests prove default/override and serialized filter/retrieval contracts; dotnet build.
- [ ] validation-attribution: Invalid filter/date/order/history limits return problem details; mixed reducer attribution totals do not duplicate request savings; time buckets use UTC and ISO Monday weeks.
  - check: Gain API tests assert invalid inputs and mixed reducer fixture sums plus timezone and week/month edge cases.

**S2 — A Spectre CLI renders and filters the proxy gain API as static, structured and live views. (in_progress)**
- [ ] views: Each supported gain option maps to real API fields/filtering and text/graph/history/time/attribution output correctly represents nonempty and empty reports.
  - check: CLI command tests with seeded fake HTTP responses cover every supported option and combinations; remove query mapping and observe scoped test fail.
- [ ] formats: JSON is parseable without banners/ANSI and CSV escapes comma/quote/newline fields; --project uses normalized caller cwd exact-match.
  - check: Execute command tests parse stdout as JSON/CSV and assert encoded HTTP query; inject banner or omit project and observe failure.
- [ ] reset-watch: Reset calls mutation API only after confirmation/--yes; watch refreshes and cancels while --text remains static.
  - check: CLI tests decline/accept/noninteractive confirmations and cancellation-controlled watch count; bypass confirmation and observe failure. Assert watch+JSON/CSV rejection before HTTP, text override and noninteractive watch exit.
- [ ] capabilities: Unsupported quota/tier/shadow/skip-env options return actionable nonzero errors; endpoint/HTTP failures are clear and do not appear as zero savings.
  - check: Command tests assert exit status/stdout/stderr and absence of network/reset calls for unsupported input.
- [ ] mode-validation: Incompatible watch/structured output rejected before network; text wins over watch; redirected watch never hangs.
  - check: CLI parse/execute tests assert zero requests and nonzero exit for unsupported combinations, single request for --watch --text.

**S3 — A packaged stdio MCP server exposes retrieval with complete annotations and derived inventory. (in_progress)**
- [ ] wire: Real stdio initialize/tools/list returns exactly retrieve_original with four boolean hints explicitly present; tools/call by name reaches proxy and returns content/errors correctly.
  - check: MCP process integration tests with fake local HTTP server assert wire requests, whole/lines/pattern, missing/error and zero-match; remove hint/handler mapping and observe failure.
- [ ] inventory: Derived inventory matches actual registered tools and omissions of name or explicit boolean hints are rejected by generator validation.
  - check: Generator synthetic-source tests add a tool and remove each required named argument; observe expected generated name/diagnostic.
- [ ] adapter: MCP depends on shared client only, honors endpoint/cancellation and has no SQLite/file mutation behavior.
  - check: dotnet build src/AiProxy.Mcp; dependency check and HTTP failure/cancellation tests.
